transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?

I guess I’ve been worrying a lot more than I used to. About work, clients, the market… family things, money. Even whether moving to the condo was the right choice. It just feels like more worry than the situation really calls for.
Do you find that your anxiety is especially strong in social situations, or when you're around other people?
I don’t think so. I mean, being around people can be tiring sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed the anxiety being specifically about social situations.
Have you noticed any physical symptoms, like restlessness, fatigue, trouble concentrating, or trouble sleeping, that seem to go along with this increased worry?

Mostly sleep, I think. I’ll get into bed at a normal time, but then my mind just keeps going over things… condo fees, showings the next day, whether I missed something in a contract. It can take a long time to settle down, and I wake up feeling like I didn’t really rest.
Have you noticed these feelings of worry and trouble sleeping happening more often than not over the past several months?
Yes… more often than not, I’d say. It’s been going on for about a year or so—maybe a year and two months—since after I sold my house and moved into the condo.
